name: Telegram / Pushover
author: Lichtspiel
description: Sends a message to Telegram and/or Pushover when something happens: new movies and episodes (one message per scan, with the poster when there is one), playback, problems reported, invites and new users. Telegram: the token of a bot made with @BotFather (telegram_bot_token); then connect a chat or group under Settings → Account. Pushover: the app's token (pushover_token) and the user or group keys (pushover_users). "events" chooses what is sent: library.item.added, library.scan.finished, playback.started, playback.stopped, playback.watched, item.problem, download.ready, user.invited, user.joined, server.started. "disk_warnings": a message when a library's disk or the data folder's is nearly full (the limit is under Settings → Library; true unless set to false). "language": "de" or "en" (empty = the language of the admin who opened the panel last).
